Less repetition at the table

Your spell. Your triggers.

The spell's own activities define saves and damage. The module connects those activities to the Region events you choose.

I.

Choose the moment

Run activities when a token enters, exits, moves within, starts its turn, or ends its turn inside the Region.

II.

Choose the creatures

Set per-trigger targeting and optional Once Per Turn limits. Disposition filters compare each token to the caster.

III.

Keep the cast connected

Follow-up activities retain the cast level without spending resources again. Linked Regions are removed when concentration ends.

How to use

From spell item
to living Region.

Start with one spell. Match its activity names, pick its events, and test a fresh cast.

Keep an active GM connected. Setup and activity resolution still need your table's attention.

  1. Prepare the spell

    Use a spell whose casting activity creates a D&D5e Region. Add the follow-up activities you need to that same item, such as a recurring save or damage activity.

  2. Open the spell manager

    Enable the module in your D&D5e world. As GM, go to Compendiums → Open Region Spell Manager, or Configure Settings → Region Spell Automation → Manage Region Spells.

  3. Build the configuration

    Add the spell and match spell and activity names exactly. Choose trigger events, targeting, and Once Per Turn settings. Add existing Active Effects as Region Effects if needed.

  4. Cast, test, refine

    Enable the configuration, cast the spell, and place the area. Test its events and effects, then end concentration to check cleanup. Recast after changing the configuration.

Separate moments

Hunger of Hadar

Connect a cold-damage activity to turn start and an acid save/damage activity to turn end. Two triggers keep the two moments separate.

Turn start → damage   ·   Turn end → save
Movement that adds up

Spike Growth

Use Movement Damage with a Damage activity and a 5-foot increment on a feet-based scene. Movement accumulates pending damage for you to roll and apply.

Movement → pending increments → roll damage
A starting point, not a finished spell item. Add Starting Spell List loads six missing recipes, disabled for review. It preserves existing configurations and does not create spell items, activities, or effects. Match the names, review the settings, then enable each recipe.
Good to know

A few details before you cast.

What versions is this built for?

The local module manifest declares v0.5.7, Foundry VTT v14, and the D&D5e system with a minimum of 6.0.5 and verified version 6.0.6. Later versions need testing. No additional module dependencies are declared.

Does it resolve everything automatically?

Activity workflows can still need saving throws, damage rolls, and other interaction. Movement Damage creates a pending damage card; damage application remains manual. Vision, obscuration, and individual spell exemptions need their own setup.

What does Once Per Turn mean?

One use per target during the current combat turn, including another creature's turn. It is not once per round. Multiple events on the same trigger share the allowance.

Why did changing a trigger not update my area?

Existing Regions keep the behaviors attached when they were created. Cast the spell again after changing events or Region Effects. Check exact spell and activity names, the enabled configuration, and your targeting settings.

Can I use any Region drawn on the scene?

The activity workflow needs D&D5e origin metadata linking the Region to the spell item. An arbitrary manually drawn Region is insufficient. Keep an active GM connected when spells create Regions and during movement damage tracking.
